comparison_tracks.description: Primary paired comparison of standard/core.md v0.2.0 against frozen provider-native baseline across three origin: real_work pinned OSS scenarios (RW3, RW5, RW6) and one polyglot engineering-credibility PR audit (SE2) over n = 3 replicates per cell.
Per-model delta overlay ablation testing model-specific rules from gates/model_deltas.json layered on top of standard/core.md v0.2.0 across RW3, RW5, RW6, and SE2 over n = 3 replicates per cell.
End-to-end comparison of standard/core.md v0.2.0 + per-model delta overlays against provider-native baseline across RW3, RW5, RW6, and SE2 over n = 3 replicates per cell.

limits: Mixed public suite comprising 75% origin: real_work pinned Nov 2026 OSS scenarios (RW3 urllib3, RW5 sqlparse, RW6 tomlkit) and 25% constructed polyglot engineering-credibility audit (SE2); report origin: real_work and origin: constructed outcomes separately rather than pooling into a single real-work claim.
Replicates (n = 3 per model x case x condition cell), models (4 focus models), and lineage stages (2 stages per run) are not additional independent task scenarios.

Requires isolated per-run CODEX_HOME and HOME directories (zero personal skills or user configs) and deterministic pre-hash artifact sanitization in scripts/run_benchmark.py before recording SHA-256 hashes.
Never substitute a different model without a new explicitly labelled experiment.
